summary: Collegium Pharmaceutical filed an 8-K on May 12, 2026, announcing the closing of its acquisition of AZSTARYS, a CNS stimulant for ADHD, via the purchase of all membership interests in GPC Commave Holding, LLC and Commave Sub, LLC from Corium Therapeutics Holdings and Corium, LLC. The aggregate consideration was ~$650 million in cash, funded by ~$350 million cash on hand and $300 million from a delayed-draw term loan under a syndicated credit facility. Upside milestone payments of up to $135 million are contingent on AZSTARYS achieving commercial and manufacturing targets. The board had previously approved the transaction; no advisor named. The deal closed on schedule with no regulatory overhang. Watch for future milestone triggers and integration execution.
